value.rationale: A 5-by-5 toroidal king graph is the first natural nontrivial odd square of a periodic strong product motivated by current independence polynomial studies. Its known polynomial fixes only Euler data, whereas a precise integral sphere-wedge homotopy type and the first full translation character resolve nontrivial topology and distinguish two geometrically meaningful order-five quotient classes (25 versus 29) and the full translation quotient (rank five). The result is finite but a complete natural, motivated classification rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
